## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Index core on real data
      Objective: Load one real closed quarter's master index and one real published daily index into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1 (core)
      Consumes: nothing; the package scaffolds only
      Produces: a filing-index table built from real SEC index files; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: the table holds the rows of one real quarterly and one real daily index; the findings file records the bytes downloaded, row counts, elapsed time and observed request rate of that run
      Leaves out: full history and daily catch-up (Stage 2); raw-snapshot retention, manifest, provenance and replay (Stage 5); reconciliation, withdrawals and versioned publication (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Full index history and daily catch-up
      Objective: Extend the index table to the full configured quarterly range and every daily index through the present.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 1's table and its findings file
      Produces: a filing-index table covering the configured range through the latest published daily index, with a per-source result report
      Exit: every quarterly and daily source in the range is reported as ingested, pending or failed, with no source missing from the report; a rerun after an interrupted run picks up the remaining sources
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot retention, manifest, provenance and replay (Stage 5); reconciliation, withdrawals and versioned publication (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: Submissions download
      Objective: Download the individual submissions that the index table's rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 2's index table
      Produces: the submissions on disk, each findable from its index row, with a per-row result report
      Exit: every index row's submission is on disk or reported as pending or failed; the run records its elapsed time, bytes stored and observed request rate
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot retention, manifest, provenance and replay (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 3's submissions on disk and Stage 2's index table
      Produces: the main document of each 10-K and 8-K filing, extracted, with a per-filing result report
      Exit: every 10-K and 8-K row in the index table has an extracted main document or is reported as failed with a reason; the run records its elapsed time and output volume
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot retention, manifest, provenance and replay (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Raw-snapshot retention, manifest, provenance and replay
      Objective: Keep original bytes and a manifest so that every output can be traced to its source and rebuilt without new SEC requests.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–4 shipped
      Produces: retained raw source files, a manifest of sources, snapshots and processing states, and a replay path from stored bytes
      Exit: rebuilding the index table and the 10-K/8-K extracts with SEC access disabled makes zero SEC requests and gives the same rows; each output row names its source file and content hash
      Leaves out: reconciliation, withdrawals and versioned publication (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Reconciliation, withdrawals and versioned publication
      Objective: Re-read the quarterly indexes, record their changes, gate removals, and publish each quarter as a complete version.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 5's manifest and retained raw files
      Produces: per-quarter published versions behind one active reference, with change records and withdrawal approvals
      Exit: a re-read quarterly index with changed rows publishes a new quarter version whose change record lists its additions and updates; a version that would remove rows stays unpublished until approved; readers see only complete versions
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Full validation suite
      Objective: Cover the shipped system with committed fixtures and mocked SEC responses that run in CI.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–6 shipped
      Produces: a CI suite with no SEC downloads, covering index formats across the supported range, malformed and HTML responses, and interrupted runs
      Exit: the suite passes in CI with zero network requests to the SEC, and a deliberately malformed fixture fails it
      Leaves out: scheduling, deployment and monitoring (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 8: Scheduling, deployment and monitoring
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and reconciliation on a schedule on the chosen platform, with alerts and runbooks.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–7 shipped; the platform choice (the ADR's Azure proposal is background, not yet a choice made)
      Produces: a deployed, scheduled system with durable run reports, alerts and runbooks
      Exit: at least one observed scheduled daily run and one scheduled reconciliation run each leave a durable run report; an injected failure raises an alert
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
